description:
Record money received against threads and produce billed-versus-received statements. Records are stored in threads/<Kind>/<Name>/payments.md.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD AMOUNT [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — record a payment received
  list [THREAD] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — list payments
  statement [--thread T] [--since D] [--until D] [--as-of D] [--pdf PATH] [--json] — billed vs received, by thread and currency
  show ID [--json] — show one payment
  edit ID [--amount N] [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — change fields of a payment
  rm ID -y — permanently delete a payment

Args:
  THREAD / --thread T: thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink.
  AMOUNT: positive decimal, e.g. 12500.00. Required even though usage shows it as optional.
  ID: the payment's 8-character id, from `payments list`.
  D / DATE: YYYY-MM-DD.

Flags:
  log:
    -c, --currency CODE   ISO code (default: the thread's)
    -d, --date YYYY-MM-DD   date received (default today)
    -t, --time HH:MM   default now
    -a, --account TEXT   account the money landed in
    -n, --note TEXT   free-text note
  list:
    --since D, --until D   inclusive date bounds
    --json   JSON output
  statement:
    --since D, --until D   inclusive date bounds
    --as-of D   statement date; drives aging (default today)
    --pdf PATH   render a PDF to this path; requires --thread
    --json   JSON output
  show:
    --json   JSON output
  edit:
    --amount N, -c/--currency CODE, -d/--date YYYY-MM-DD, -t/--time HH:MM, -a/--account TEXT, -n/--note TEXT   new values
  rm:
    -y, --yes   required to confirm the delete

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "12500.00", "-c", "ZAR", "-d", "2026-09-30", "-a", "Business cheque"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--pdf", "SGB-statement.pdf"]
  ["list", "Projects/SGB", "--since", "2026-01-01"]

Notes:
  -n/--note takes several words and swallows any element after it that is not a flag. Put THREAD AMOUNT (log) or ID (edit) before every flag, and -n last.
  A payment must have a currency: pass -c or set one on the thread.
  log also adds a REF: line to buffer.md, filed under the date received.
  rm is permanent.
  Exit 1: missing, invalid or non-positive amount, --pdf without --thread, or nothing to state for the thread.
